section_1.title: Introduction: From Sequential Reading to Global Context
section_1.content: Briefly explain the limitation of traditional RNNs (reading word-by-word) versus the Transformer's ability to process an entire sentence simultaneously, inspired by how humans scan a page.
section_1.example: Comparing a person reading a book one word at a time versus a photographer taking a high-resolution snapshot of the entire page at once.

section_2.title: Prerequisite Concept: Embeddings and Vector Space
section_2.content: Introduce the idea of 'Semantic Space.' Explain that words are converted into multi-dimensional vectors where similar meanings (e.g., 'King' and 'Queen') are physically closer in space.
section_2.example: Visualizing a 3D coordinate system where 'Dog' and 'Puppy' are clustered together as neighbors, while 'Toaster' is in a distant corner.

section_3.title: The Core Engine: Self-Attention Mechanism
section_3.content: Explain Self-Attention as a 'Relevance Map.' Every word looks at every other word in the sequence to determine the context. Mathematically, this is modeled as Dot-Product Attention: calculating Query, Key, and Value vectors.
section_3.example: In the sentence 'The animal didn't cross the street because it was too tired,' the model draws a glowing line connecting 'it' to 'animal,' highlighting the dependency.

section_4.title: Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM
section_4.content: Describe how stacking these Transformer blocks hundreds of layers deep, and training on massive datasets, allows the model to capture complex patterns, nuances, and reasoning.
section_4.example: An 'AI Librarian' who has read every book in a massive library and can now synthesize information to write a poem or debug code.

section_5.title: Conclusion: The Generative Loop
section_5.content: Briefly demonstrate how LLMs use 'Next Token Prediction' to generate text, essentially playing a high-stakes game of 'guess the next word' based on the patterns learned.
section_5.example: A robotic parrot that, instead of repeating phrases, predicts the most probable next word to complete a story based on everything it has learned previously.

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2

class Section1Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup Title and Lecture
        title = Text("Introduction: From Sequential Reading to Global Context", font_size=28).to_edge(UP)
        lecture_lines = [
            "RNNs process text word by word sequentially.",
            "This approach limits understanding of global context.",
            "Transformers read entire sequences simultaneously instead."
        ]
        lecture = VGroup(*[Text(line, font_size=22) for line in lecture_lines])
        lecture.arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8).to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(title, lecture)

        # Create elements
        words = VGroup(*[Text("Word", font_size=24, color=YELLOW) for _ in range(3)])
        words.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5).shift(UP * 1.5)
        
        context_box = VGroup(
            Square(side_length=1.5, color=BLUE),
            Text("Context", font_size=20)
        ).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        
        lines = VGroup(*[Line(start=words[i].get_bottom(), end=context_box.get_top(), color=BLUE) for i in range(3)])

        # Animations
        self.play(FadeIn(lecture[0]), Write(words))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(lecture[1]), Create(lines), FadeIn(context_box))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        glow = Dot(color=WHITE, radius=0.2).move_to(context_box.get_center())
        self.play(
            FadeIn(lecture[2]),
            context_box[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            FadeIn(glow)
        )
        
        self.play(
            lecture[0].animate.set_color(GRAY),
            lecture[1].animate.set_color(GRAY),
            lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )
        self.wait(2)
